summary: Iteration 7 (Concierge WhatsApp + Admin Dashboard with Emergent Google Auth) tested end-to-end. All 17 backend pytest cases pass (auth gates, admin orders/stats/patch, expired/non-admin sessions, regression on products/orders/content). Frontend Playwright validated: hero-concierge-link href + encoded copy, login gate, redirect to auth.emergentagent.com, admin dashboard render with 4 KPI cards + 38 order rows + voucher breakdown (FIRSTBUY20K visible), non-admin block, and logout flow. Fixed 1 broken import path that was preventing webpack compile.
action_items: (Already fixed by tester) AuthCallback.jsx had wrong relative import '../lib/auth' which broke webpack compile. Corrected to '../../lib/auth'. Main agent should be aware so future edits to that file don't reintroduce.

Optional: PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/status returns {ok:false} for invalid status with HTTP 200 — consider returning HTTP 400 for stricter REST semantics (current behaviour matches the spec, so this is informational only).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py current_user properly excludes mongo _id with projection — good.
admin.py correctly projects {_id:0} on orders.find — verified no _id leakage in API responses.
auth.py logout is idempotent (200 with {ok:true}) even without session — meets spec.
Cookie attributes set correctly (httpOnly, secure, sameSite=None) for cross-site preview hosting.
AuthCallback.jsx import path was wrong before fix; this would have completely broken /admin#session_id= flow in production. Recommend adding a smoke-test that imports each route file.
test_credentials: Admin sessions injected via mongosh into users + user_sessions collections (admin@rimpods.test whitelisted, hacker@rimpods-external.com for 403). Cleanup performed after testing.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 user docs and 2 user_sessions during testing; created a few TEST_ orders for status patch verification. All cleaned up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_v7_admin_auth.py — reuse _inject_session helper for any future auth-protected endpoint testing. Cookie domain for Playwright must be 'coral-product-hub.preview.emergentagent.com' with sameSite=None, secure=True. The expired-session test relies on backend deleting the row when expires_at < now (auth.py:56) — keep that contract.
rca of the issue: Pre-existing bug found and fixed: AuthCallback.jsx imported '../lib/auth' but file lives 2 levels up at src/lib/auth.js (callback is at src/pages/admin/). Webpack compile failed, causing the entire SPA to fail to build whenever AuthCallback was reached or hot-reloaded. Fix: change import to '../../lib/auth'. After fix, webpack compiles cleanly and all routes render.
